C14 and C03 are also strong earlier versions of the same recurring template, but C04 is temporally closer and matches the child's wording most precisely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Section 202(d) of the National Emergencies Act (50 U.S.C. 1622(d)) provides for the automatic termination of a national emergency unless, prior to the anniversary date of its declaration, the President publishes in the Federal Register and transmits to the Congress a notice stating that the emergency is to continue in effect beyond the anniversary date.","parent_excerpt":"Section 202(d) of the National Emergencies Act (50 U.S.C. 1622(d)) provides for the automatic termination of a national emergency unless, prior to the anniversary date of its declaration, the President publishes in the Federal Register and transmits to the Congress a notice stating that the emergency is to continue in effect beyond the anniversary date.","explanation":"Exact, extended statutory framing shared by the two letters."},{"child_excerpt":"The crisis between the United States and Iran that began in 1979 has not been fully resolved. The international tribunal established to adjudicate claims of the United States and U.S. nationals against Iran and of the Iranian Government and Iranian nationals against the United States continues to function, and normalization of commercial and diplomatic relations between the United States and Iran has not been achieved.","parent_excerpt":"The crisis between the United States and Iran that began in 1979 has not been fully resolved. While the international tribunal established to adjudicate claims of U.S. nationals against Iran and of Iranian nationals against the United States continues to function, normalization of commercial and diplomatic relations between the United States and Iran has not been achieved.","explanation":"The child closely reproduces the same distinctive factual predicate, with only a modest expansion of the description of claims before the tribunal."},{"child_excerpt":"In these circumstances, I have determined that it is necessary to maintain in force the broad authorities that may be needed in the process of implementing the January 1981 agreements with Iran and in the eventual normalization of relations with that country.","parent_excerpt":"In these circumstances, I have determined that it is necessary to maintain in force the broad authorities that may be needed in the process of implementing the January 1981 agreements with Iran and in the eventual normalization of relations with that country.","explanation":"The operative determination is reproduced verbatim, demonstrating concrete reuse of both language and administrative function."}]}
